desiredContract.name: Machine family
desiredContract.description: Reusable governed Rhino machine-family entity referenced by Products and potentially by later approved support-resource architecture.
desiredContract.entitySemantics: One record represents a governed Rhino machine family, not a Product, sellable configuration, compatibility assertion, or technical specification bundle.
desiredContract.reuseJustification: A family is reused across multiple machine, part, consumable, accessory, navigation, and support contexts; copied Product text would create divergent names and descriptions.
desiredContract.simplerMetafieldInsufficient: A scalar Product metafield cannot centralize a reusable family label/description or preserve reference identity across multiple Products and future support resources.

applicability.condition: Create family records and Product references only from separately approved family membership data.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Approved family-level description without unresolved technical or compatibility claims.

migration.coexistence: not_applicable
migration.rollbackConsiderations: Later plans must preserve metaobject handles/GIDs and inbound Product references; deletion and recreation is not an identity-safe rollback.

cautions: Do not use family membership as compatibility proof.
Do not place unresolved specifications in family records.
Exact Product relationships remain owned by later PBIs.

desiredContract.name: Product class
desiredContract.description: Canonical Rhino catalog role used to distinguish machines, replacement parts, consumables, and accessories without relying on Product Type, tags, or collections.

applicability.condition: Every current Rhino catalog Product in the approved four-class model has exactly one value.

customDataJustification.purpose: Rhino-specific business classification with a closed vocabulary and concrete MVP routing/filtering consumers.
customDataJustification.nativeFieldAssessment: Shopify Category is a separate official taxonomy; Product Type is intentionally blank and must not duplicate this role.

migration.coexistence: not_applicable
migration.rollbackConsiderations: Definition deletion is not harmless after values exist; later planning must preserve the classification register and before-state evidence.

cautions: Do not derive values from tags, collections, Product Type, title, or handle.
This batch does not create the definition or populate Product values.

desiredContract.name: Machine family
desiredContract.description: Reference from a Product to one governed reusable machine-family record; family membership is organizational context, not Product identity or compatibility proof.

applicability.condition: Present only after Product Data approves a family membership; absence is preferred to inference.

customDataJustification.purpose: Provides one reusable family entity for products and governed support architecture without copying mutable family names.
customDataJustification.nativeFieldAssessment: No Shopify native Product field represents Rhino machine-family membership.

migration.coexistence: not_applicable
migration.rollbackConsiderations: Later plans must preserve metaobject and Product-reference GIDs; deleting and recreating either side can break references.

cautions: Family membership is not an identity, compatibility, specification, or exact Product-relation claim.
Do not infer membership from title, handle, tags, collections, or filenames.

validationResolution.requires: Resolve exact created/audited metaobject definition GID; never use a fabricated GID.
